outcome: Maternal outcomes (e.g., preterm premature rupture of membranes)
Neonatal outcomes (e.g., revision of MMC closure after birth, VP shunt placement at 4 months)
cohort: The study included 10 patients who underwent laparotomy-assisted fetoscopic myelomeningocele repair among 39 qualifying patients with myelomeningocele.
finding: Early results indicate that laparotomy-assisted fetoscopic MMC repair is a safe option for qualified patients, with one neonate requiring VP shunt placement at 4 months and two requiring MMC closure revision after birth.
mod_finding: Four patients delivered vaginally without complications, and all trocar sites were intact at the time of cesarean deliveries.
gest_age: Median gestational age at repair was 25w4d (IQR 25w0d-26w6d), and median gestational age at delivery was 36w1d (IQR 32w2d-37w0d).
